# Kenney Tanks

Original artwork: Kenney Vleugels (Kenney.nl), Tanks pack (2017).

- Official page: https://kenney.nl/assets/tanks
- Author-uploaded mirror: https://opengameart.org/content/tank-pack-80
- Download: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/kenney_tanksPack.zip
- License: CC0; original License.txt retained alongside these files.

Only eleven original Retina PNG files are included. No source pixels were modified.
Unity fits the separate hull, tracks and barrel to the existing gameplay rig.
Green hulls represent the player; navy hulls represent the enemy.
The full-tank images are selection thumbnails; gameplay uses separate aiming parts.
